Business Description: 
 
Project Arch operates office product retail stores and an online shopping and distribution platform. The company offers a range of office supplies, 
business technology products, facility and breakroom supplies, computers and mobility products, and office furniture. It also provides print, marketing, 
and technology services directly to businesses and consumers.

Business Description: 
 
Project Ascent is an aviation infrastructure services platform serving the commercial aviation, general and business aviation, and cargo end markets 
principally in North America and Europe. 
 
 
Fund Name: 
Project Board 
Underperforming 
Investment Type: 
Private Equity – Co-Investment 
Vintage: 
2022 
Commitment: 
$5.0 million 
Business Description: 
 
Project Board is a leading provider of back-end software to 2,100+ higher education institutions (over 13 million students & 3 million faculty / 
administrative users), supporting the entire learner lifecycle. Core products include student information systems, enterprise resource planning, 
constituent relationship management software, and various tools to improve student outcomes / retention and enhance student / alumni engagement. 
 
 
Investment Name: 
Project Bruins 
Outperforming 
Investment Type: 
Private Equity – Co-Investment 
Vintage: 
2016 
Commitment: 
$10.0 million 
Business Description: 
 
Project Bruins (“Bruins”) is a Massachusetts-based healthcare service provider that leverages data analytics and technology to limit costs and ensure 
regulatory compliance for various stakeholders in the healthcare industry, including payors, providers, and employers.
